subject.title: Feature Request: Stream Repetition Safeguard (Halt & Confirm)

question: What product contract should OpenClaw use when assistant text repeats in a stream: abort-only, pause-and-confirm, retry/failover, session rollback, or a narrower combination?
rationale: The source boundary is clear, but default strictness, false-positive tolerance, whether `/approve` may resume suspect output, and how to sanitize session history are product and compatibility decisions automation should not invent.

options.title: Define a core stream guard
options.body: Specify thresholds, alert copy, abort/retry/resume behavior, and session cleanup before implementation in the embedded-agent stream path.

options.title: Defer to timeout work
options.body: Keep this issue open but wait for generation-timeout and provider-watchdog decisions before adding semantic stream detection.

options.title: Reject resume semantics
options.body: Allow a detector only to abort and quarantine the turn, avoiding a manual resume path that might continue looped output.

recommendation.title: Define a core stream guard
recommendation.body: Specify thresholds, alert copy, abort/retry/resume behavior, and session cleanup before implementation in the embedded-agent stream path.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest adjacent history for loop/config behavior and already appears as the product-review owner for related runaway-generation decisions.
